info.title: Dolores desktop shell contracts
info.description: No HTTP API. Selected Flutter shell uses the in-process C ABI in x-flutter-ffi. x-tauri-commands describes alternative Tauri IPC; Iced uses internal Rust events.

free.ownership: Free each live dolores_call result exactly once; null allowed.

arguments.apiKey: string|null; optional; null/omitted reuses active/saved key only for same endpoint, or empty if none
arguments.rememberConnection: boolean; optional; default false; true stores key in OS credential store
arguments.enabledModels: string[]; optional; 1..32 valid IDs including active model; defaults to [preferences.model]

recoverConnection.result: null; reload saved connection; failure clears provider and sets connectionWarning

listModels.result: string[]; sorted unique valid IDs from GET <baseUrl>/models; 20-second timeout, 1 MiB response and 512-entry caps; no configuration changes

selectModel.result: null; persist active model/metadata atomically, preserve key and history

forgetConnection.result: null; deletes saved key/reference and active connection, preserves history/preferences

arguments.workspace: absolute folder string|null; optional; enables approved read-only tools for this run, never remembered or sent to provider

cancel.result: null; stale IDs are a no-op

shutdown.result: null; cancels active run, preserves process-wide engine

arguments.newer: boolean; optional/default false; true requires cursor

sessionsPage.result: {items:Session[0..50],hasOlder:boolean,hasNewer:boolean}; updatedAt descending, id ascending; cursor excluded; newer query reverses internally to return same display order

arguments.newer: boolean; optional/default false; true requires cursor

messagesPage.result: {items:{id:i64,role:user|assistant,content:string,metadata?:TurnMetadata}[0..80],hasOlder:boolean,hasNewer:boolean}; chronological id order; no cursor loads latest; older/newer excludes cursor

arguments.path: absolute string path with .md or .json extension matching format; destination must not exist

export.result: {messageCount:u64}; complete read snapshot streamed to sibling temporary file, synced and published without replacement; no partial destination on write failure; existing files rejected

arguments.session: string|null; optional; null previews a new conversation without creating it
arguments.input: string; empty allowed; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes
arguments.tools: boolean; optional/default false; appends local tool guidance and applies the same initial context trimming as start

context.result: ContextSummary & {messages:{role:system|user|assistant,content:string}[0..82]}; exact prepared sequence including system and final draft (empty allowed), at most 131072 UTF-8 content bytes; independent of viewed page; no network, writes, credentials or HTTP envelope

setRequestSettings.result: null; validates and persists nonsecret settings, activates the replacement provider after save; no network or credential changes; rejected during generation

approveTool.result: null; consumes matching approval once; stale/repeated/mismatched/stopped decisions rejected

x-flutter-ffi.busy: Only poll, cancel, approveTool and shutdown are accepted until the terminal event is drained.

exportSchema.messages: {id:i64,role:user|assistant,content:string,metadata?:TurnMetadata}[]; entire chronological conversation, no credentials/preferences; Markdown preserves title and bodies in variable-length text fences; optional metadata is included in JSON and as an inert text-fenced record in Markdown

accounting.metadata: Completed assistant metadata {model,usage:TokenUsage|null,context:ContextSummary,requestSettings?:RequestSettings}; actual provider snapshot, omitted for old messages/unsupported providers. Text and metadata commit together; delete cascades both. Optional agent:AgentSummary on successful tool runs; top-level usage is null, per-call usage remains separate. File contents are persisted/exported; folder root is excluded. Schema stays 5.
accounting.context: UTF-8 content bytes including system and current user message; excludes JSON/role overhead. Max 131072 bytes and 40 saved complete turns; not a model token-window guarantee. savedTurns/omittedTurns may be null for plugins without total-count support.
accounting.usage: Provider-reported counters only; missing, null, negative, fractional, string and values over 9007199254740991 remain unavailable. Zero is preserved. Cached/reasoning counts are breakdowns, not additions. No estimated totals, prices, tokenizer or cumulative session totals.

requestControls.timeout: One whole-provider-response deadline including headers, streamed body, queue waits and bounded usage fallback; excludes history reads/final persistence. Fixed 10-second connect and 20-second discovery timeouts remain.
requestControls.recovery: Manual actions only; never automatic failure retry. Retry sends the current edited draft. Guidance uses fixed local strings and does not expose raw provider bodies.

folderTools.name: read_text_file
folderTools.approval: Every valid read requires a run-bound single-use Allow once/Deny. Denied targets are not prompted again in the same run. Stop/timeout/shutdown clear pending approvals.
folderTools.timeout: min(configured timeoutSeconds,300) for the whole model/tool/approval phase, excluding initial preparation and final persistence; OS filesystem calls cannot be forcibly interrupted
folderTools.paths: Relative forward slashes; regular UTF-8 files only; rejects traversal/absolute/control/device/credential/VCS names, binary/NUL/oversized content and outside symlink/junction targets; capability-relative resolution/open after approval. The name filter does not identify every possible secret.
folderTools.persistence: Successful final answer and agent metadata commit with the user message; no partial pairs on Stop/failure/exhaustion. Approved contents are shared with the provider and retained in unencrypted metadata/export. Failed-run cards remain transient.

apiKey.description: Required argument, may be empty; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no CR/LF; replaces the in-memory credential.

x-error-result.description: Invocation rejection with a user-facing error; no stable error codes in v1.

baseUrl.description: At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; HTTPS or HTTP loopback, no userinfo/query/fragment.

model.description: Nonblank, at most 200 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.

DeltaEvent.description: First event has an empty delta acknowledging native run reservation; subsequent events contain ordered plain text.

retryable.description: Manual retry action only; does not initiate a new request.

guidance.description: Fixed local text; never a raw provider body.

target.description: Resolved relative path, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; never absolute root
Relative target or fixed blocked-path label; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes

content.description: At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; literal file content or fixed local refusal/error

x-provider-chat.response: text/event-stream; usage may arrive in an empty-choices chunk before [DONE]; last valid snapshot replaces, never sums prior snapshots
x-provider-chat.compatibility: Retry once without stream_options only after HTTP 400/422 with an <=8192-byte JSON error explicitly naming stream_options/include_usage as unsupported/unknown/unrecognized/unexpected/not permitted. Never retry denial, generic validation, transport or stream failures. Error bodies are not surfaced.

x-provider-tools.messages: Initial system/history/user, then assistant tool_calls:[{id,type:function,function:{name,arguments}}], followed by tool messages {role:tool,content,tool_call_id:id}; local approval/policy runs before tool content is shared
x-provider-tools.response: application/json; bounded choices[0].message with content/tool_calls, usage and finish_reason stop|tool_calls; malformed/incomplete/output-limited responses fail
x-provider-tools.compatibility: No tool fallback or automatic failure retry. Ordinary chat stays SSE.
